title: permit_revert_on_expired_or_zero_owner
description: permit reverts if block.timestamp > deadline or owner is the zero address.

title: permit_effects
description: A successful permit(owner, spender, value, ...) sets allowance[owner][spender] to exactly value, increments nonces[owner] by exactly one, and changes no other allowance, nonce or balance.

title: nonces_only_increase_via_permit
description: For any SavingsDai method, nonces never decrease; a nonce changes only by a successful permit for that owner, and then by exactly one.

title: permit_signature_forms_equivalent
description: permit(owner, spender, value, deadline, v, r, s) behaves exactly like permit(owner, spender, value, deadline, abi.encodePacked(r, s, v)): same revert behaviour and same resulting allowance and nonce. (Pass 4: extend to the ERC-1271 fallback path by modelling isValidSignature as a deterministic function of (signer, digest), so the two forms' identical staticcalls get the same answer.)
